# The Chess Herald

> The Chess Herald is a curated chess news site. For a small set of the day's most
> newsworthy chess stories, it publishes an original companion analysis
> piece alongside a link to the original source article -- never a
> reworded summary. Companion pieces are AI-drafted (Claude, credited as
> "Claude Henry" on every article) under human editorial review before
> publishing, and add real context: a historical parallel, the money/
> economics angle, community reaction (grounded in live web search, not
> speculation), or original reporting drawn from Chess Tournament
> Calendar's own tournament database.

## Key facts

- Every article's frontmatter and byline names its real primary source;
  the source URL is always linked, both inline and at the article's end.
- Article images are real, correctly licensed photos from Wikimedia
  Commons (never scraped from the source outlet), with visible credit and
  a link back to the original file.
- "reviewStatus: published" in an article's frontmatter is the signal a
  human editor has reviewed and approved that specific piece.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://chessherald.com/): latest published articles.
- [All Articles](https://chessherald.com/archive/): every published article, newest first.
- [Europe](https://chessherald.com/continent/europe/): Europe section.
- [Asia](https://chessherald.com/continent/asia/): Asia section.
- [North America](https://chessherald.com/continent/north-america/): North America section.
- [South America](https://chessherald.com/continent/south-america/): South America section.
- [Africa](https://chessherald.com/continent/africa/): Africa section.
- [Oceania](https://chessherald.com/continent/oceania/): Oceania section.
- [Global](https://chessherald.com/continent/global/): stories with no single regional angle.
- [RSS feed](https://chessherald.com/rss.xml): all published articles.
- [Sitemap](https://chessherald.com/sitemap-index.xml): full URL index.

## Reuse

Article text may be quoted with attribution to [The Chess Herald](https://chessherald.com/)
and a link back to the specific article. The original source article linked
from each piece carries its own outlet's rights, separate from The Chess Herald's
own analysis text.
